docs.summary: Specifies that a GameObject must have certain components in addition to the one where this attribute is applied.
docs.remarks: When this attribute is used on a component, the Prowl Game Engine will automatically add the required components to the GameObject if they are not already present. This ensures that the component has all its dependencies met. This attribute can only be applied to classes (typically components deriving from Component).

docs.summary: Gets the array of component types that are required by this component.
Initializes a new instance of the RequireComponentAttribute class.
docs.example: [RequireComponent(typeof(Rigidbody), typeof(Collider))] public class MyPhysicsComponent : Component { // This component requires both a Rigidbody and a Collider }

params.types: An array of Type objects representing the required components.
